options.content: Pilots: Traffic · New pilots · Origins · Records · Routes · **Aircraft** · Military | ATC: Overview · Retention · Hours · Positions · Ranks | Events: Monday events | Management: Health All times are UTC. Figures cover VATPAC airspace. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position; a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight). Each panel has a fixed period and a fixed number of rows, stated in its title and description; the page has no inputs.

panels.title: Most popular aircraft by flights (last 6 months)
panels.description: Flights per aircraft category over the last 6 months. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(aircraft_category, 'Other / uncategorised') AS category,
       count(*) AS flights,
       count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.aircraft_icao IS NOT NULL AND f.aircraft_icao <> ''
  AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY flights DESC

panels.title: Most popular aircraft by pilots (last 6 months)
panels.description: Pilots per aircraft category over the last 6 months. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(aircraft_category, 'Other / uncategorised') AS category,
       count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.aircraft_icao IS NOT NULL AND f.aircraft_icao <> ''
  AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY pilots DESC

panels.title: Most popular aircraft types (last 30 days, top 10)
panels.description: The ten aircraft types (the ICAO code on the flight plan, such as A388 or B738) with the most flights that finished in the last 30 days (UTC, ending now), with the number of distinct pilots. Flights with airborne time and a filed aircraft type only; the placeholder type ZZZZ is left out; ties by type code. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT f.aircraft_icao AS "Aircraft type", count(*) AS "Flights", count(DISTINCT f.cid) AS "Pilots"
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
  AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
  AND f.aircraft_icao IS NOT NULL AND f.aircraft_icao <> ''
  AND f.aircraft_icao <> 'ZZZZ'
GROUP BY f.aircraft_icao
ORDER BY count(*) DESC, f.aircraft_icao
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Most popular airlines (last 30 days)
panels.description: Most popular airlines by flights over the last 30 days. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(airline_name, airline_prefix) AS airline,
       count(*) AS flights,
       count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND airline_prefix IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY airline_prefix, airline_name
ORDER BY flights DESC, pilots DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Airlines with the most airborne hours (last 30 days, top 10)
panels.description: The ten airlines (callsign of three letters followed by a digit, matched to the airline list) with the most airborne hours over flights that finished in the last 30 days (UTC, ending now), hours to one decimal place, with the number of flights. Airborne hours, not time connected; flights with airborne time only; ties by airline prefix. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(f.airline_name, f.airline_prefix) AS "Airline",
       round((sum(f.airborne_minutes) / 60.0)::numeric, 1) AS "Airborne hours",
       count(*) AS "Flights"
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
  AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
  AND f.airline_prefix IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY f.airline_prefix, f.airline_name
ORDER BY sum(f.airborne_minutes) DESC, f.airline_prefix
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Most popular callsigns (last 30 days)
panels.description: Most popular callsigns and routes flown by at least 2 pilots over the last 30 days. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT callsign, departure, arrival,
       count(DISTINCT cid) AS unique_pilots,
       count(*) AS total_flights
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY callsign, departure, arrival
HAVING count(DISTINCT cid) >= 2
ORDER BY unique_pilots DESC, total_flights DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Highest groundspeeds (last 7 days)
panels.description: Highest peak groundspeeds per callsign over the last 7 days. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT callsign, pilot, aircraft_icao AS aircraft, departure, arrival,
       max_gs_kt AS "Peak groundspeed (kt)", max_alt_ft AS "Highest altitude (ft)", end_time AS "Flight ended"
FROM (
  SELECT f.callsign, f.name AS pilot, f.aircraft_icao, f.departure, f.arrival, f.max_gs_kt, f.max_alt_ft, f.end_time,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY f.callsign ORDER BY f.max_gs_kt DESC, f.end_time DESC) AS rn
  FROM flight_ext f
  WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND f.max_gs_kt > 100 AND f.max_gs_kt <= 750
    AND f.max_alt_ft > 1000
    AND f.arrival IS NOT NULL AND f.arrival <> ''
    AND f.aircraft_icao IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT f.is_military
    AND COALESCE(f.aircraft_category, '') NOT IN ('Supersonic', 'Business jet', 'Turboprop')
    AND f.aircraft_icao <> ALL (ARRAY['E135', 'E145', 'E170', 'E175', 'E190', 'E195',
         'F18H', 'VF35', 'BE90', 'GLF7', 'FAL7', 'FAL8', 'FAL9', 'FAL0',
         'AT42', 'DH8Q', 'PC21', 'EMB1', 'EMB2', 'EMB3', 'EMB4', 'EMB5'])
    AND f.aircraft_icao NOT LIKE 'MIG%' AND f.aircraft_icao NOT LIKE 'MIR%'
    AND f.aircraft_icao NOT LIKE 'F-%' AND f.aircraft_icao NOT LIKE 'SU-%' AND f.aircraft_icao NOT LIKE 'TU-%'
) ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY max_gs_kt DESC
LIMIT 20
